node.title: EF full-orbit pole forcing
node.statement: A genuinely full-field Galois orbit of horizontal extension-fiber components, neither base-descended nor confined to a proper intermediate subfield, must meet the extension-pole divisor. This is reduced to the proved descent of a pole-free full orbit to a B-defined horizontal cycle plus the remaining pole-free-cycle exclusion theorem.
node.falsifier: a full Galois orbit of horizontal components over a non-generating row that is not base-descended, not subfield-confined, avoids the pole divisor, and survives noncontainment
